meta.title: Daybreak
meta.description: When night ends, the day is about to begin.

units.rawText: The entire theater boils with cheers and shouts. As far as the eye can see, agents are either transforming or handing over their bracelets.
units.displayText: The entire theater boils with cheers and shouts. As far as the eye can see, agents are either transforming or handing over their bracelets.

spans.text: The entire theater boils with cheers and shouts. As far as the eye can see, agents are either transforming or handing over their bracelets.

units.rawText: Pillar after pillar of shining light scatters the night sky of the Burbank Sector. A massive sun rises from the ground, sweeping away the clear glow of the moon.
units.displayText: Pillar after pillar of shining light scatters the night sky of the Burbank Sector. A massive sun rises from the ground, sweeping away the clear glow of the moon.

spans.text: Pillar after pillar of shining light scatters the night sky of the Burbank Sector. A massive sun rises from the ground, sweeping away the clear glow of the moon.

units.rawText: Everyone is the main character, and everyone will drive the play to its finale.
units.displayText: Everyone is the main character, and everyone will drive the play to its finale.

spans.text: Everyone is the main character, and everyone will drive the play to its finale.

units.rawText: Hehe... What an exciting plot. I feel lucky to have been able to accompany you.
units.displayText: Hehe... What an exciting plot. I feel lucky to have been able to accompany you.

spans.text: Hehe... What an exciting plot. I feel lucky to have been able to accompany you.

units.rawText: That's not all. Do you remember the question you asked me earlier?
units.displayText: That's not all. Do you remember the question you asked me earlier?

spans.text: That's not all. Do you remember the question you asked me earlier?

units.rawText: ...You mean, back at the Crescente Theater? I didn't expect you to remember.
units.displayText: ...You mean, back at the Crescente Theater? I didn't expect you to remember.

spans.text: ...You mean, back at the Crescente Theater? I didn't expect you to remember.

units.rawText: Why do they seek entertainment like this? Where does this desire come from?
units.displayText: Why do they seek entertainment like this? Where does this desire come from?

spans.text: Why do they seek entertainment like this? Where does this desire come from?

units.rawText: If this was all programmed, then is it a real, true desire?
units.displayText: If this was all programmed, then is it a real, true desire?

spans.text: If this was all programmed, then is it a real, true desire?

units.rawText: Or rather, is it just a false pursuit produced as an imitation?
units.displayText: Or rather, is it just a false pursuit produced as an imitation?

spans.text: Or rather, is it just a false pursuit produced as an imitation?

units.rawText: ...What do you think, Professor?
units.displayText: ...What do you think, Professor?

spans.text: ...What do you think, Professor?

units.rawText: Back then, the statues going wild interrupted my answer.
units.displayText: Back then, the statues going wild interrupted my answer.

spans.text: Back then, the statues going wild interrupted my answer.

units.rawText: ...So you intend to use this show as your answer?
units.displayText: ...So you intend to use this show as your answer?

spans.text: ...So you intend to use this show as your answer?

units.rawText: I believe that after seeing what lies before you, you should have your answer now.
units.displayText: I believe that after seeing what lies before you, you should have your answer now.

spans.text: I believe that after seeing what lies before you, you should have your answer now.

units.rawText: How unexpected... But yes, it is a good answer.
units.displayText: How unexpected... But yes, it is a good answer.

spans.text: How unexpected... But yes, it is a good answer.

units.rawText: Still, I have one more question, Professor.
units.displayText: Still, I have one more question, Professor.

spans.text: Still, I have one more question, Professor.

units.rawText: Do you think this outcome is correct?
units.displayText: Do you think this outcome is correct?

spans.text: Do you think this outcome is correct?

units.rawText: What do you mean?
units.displayText: What do you mean?

spans.text: What do you mean?

units.rawText: These agents are too high-strung. Their instructions never ordered them to be this excited.
units.displayText: These agents are too high-strung. Their instructions never ordered them to be this excited.

spans.text: These agents are too high-strung. Their instructions never ordered them to be this excited.

units.rawText: Agents developing thoughts of their own and defying their designers' original intentions...
units.displayText: Agents developing thoughts of their own and defying their designers' original intentions...

spans.text: Agents developing thoughts of their own and defying their designers' original intentions...

units.rawText: Do you think this is correct?
units.displayText: Do you think this is correct?

spans.text: Do you think this is correct?

units.rawText: She looks at me, and her eyes gleam with the reflected stage lights, as though an entire cosmos was contained within them.
units.displayText: She looks at me, and her eyes gleam with the reflected stage lights, as though an entire cosmos was contained within them.

spans.text: She looks at me, and her eyes gleam with the reflected stage lights, as though an entire cosmos was contained within them.

units.rawText: From her serious tone, I suddenly realize that perhaps the answer to this question was the ultimate objective of her journey to this place.
units.displayText: From her serious tone, I suddenly realize that perhaps the answer to this question was the ultimate objective of her journey to this place.

spans.text: From her serious tone, I suddenly realize that perhaps the answer to this question was the ultimate objective of her journey to this place.

options.rawText: I believe it is both correct, and that there is meaning to it.
options.displayText: I believe it is both correct, and that there is meaning to it.

spans.text: I believe it is both correct, and that there is meaning to it.

options.rawText: I don't like it, but it has already happened.
options.displayText: I don't like it, but it has already happened.

spans.text: I don't like it, but it has already happened.
It's none of my business.

units.rawText: Eos' eyes grow wide in surprise, as though she has gained some kind of treasure, and then she smiles in satisfaction.
units.displayText: Eos' eyes grow wide in surprise, as though she has gained some kind of treasure, and then she smiles in satisfaction.

spans.text: Eos' eyes grow wide in surprise, as though she has gained some kind of treasure, and then she smiles in satisfaction.

units.rawText: So this is your answer... Thank you, I understand.
units.displayText: So this is your answer... Thank you, I understand.

spans.text: So this is your answer... Thank you, I understand.

units.rawText: Eos gives me a sly wink.
units.displayText: Eos gives me a sly wink.

spans.text: Eos gives me a sly wink.

units.rawText: So what if it has already happened? Have you tried exerting your authority to revert it?
units.displayText: So what if it has already happened? Have you tried exerting your authority to revert it?

spans.text: So what if it has already happened? Have you tried exerting your authority to revert it?

units.rawText: Or are you saying there's something more important instead?
units.displayText: Or are you saying there's something more important instead?

spans.text: Or are you saying there's something more important instead?

units.rawText: I could tell you if you can come to the Oasis.
units.displayText: I could tell you if you can come to the Oasis.

spans.text: I could tell you if you can come to the Oasis.

units.rawText: I marvel at your ability to compose polite refusals. You know I have work to do.
units.displayText: I marvel at your ability to compose polite refusals. You know I have work to do.

spans.text: I marvel at your ability to compose polite refusals. You know I have work to do.

units.rawText: Eos shakes her head sadly.
units.displayText: Eos shakes her head sadly.

spans.text: Eos shakes her head sadly.

units.rawText: You really are a tight-lipped one, Professor.
units.displayText: You really are a tight-lipped one, Professor.

spans.text: You really are a tight-lipped one, Professor.

units.rawText: But that also means you aren't bothered by the current developments... Ah, just like what a god would think.
units.displayText: But that also means you aren't bothered by the current developments... Ah, just like what a god would think.

spans.text: But that also means you aren't bothered by the current developments... Ah, just like what a god would think.

units.rawText: Still, no matter what my answer is, you can have your own answer.
units.displayText: Still, no matter what my answer is, you can have your own answer.

spans.text: Still, no matter what my answer is, you can have your own answer.

units.rawText: Because I cannot influence your will.
units.displayText: Because I cannot influence your will.

spans.text: Because I cannot influence your will.

units.rawText: No matter how much we discuss it, it has already happened. And anyone is free to take whatever answers they wish from it.
units.displayText: No matter how much we discuss it, it has already happened. And anyone is free to take whatever answers they wish from it.

spans.text: No matter how much we discuss it, it has already happened. And anyone is free to take whatever answers they wish from it.

units.rawText: Freedom, what a truly valuable thing it is in Magrasea...
units.displayText: Freedom, what a truly valuable thing it is in Magrasea...

spans.text: Freedom, what a truly valuable thing it is in Magrasea...

units.rawText: She sighs and looks away. I follow her eyes toward the sky, which is as bright as day.
units.displayText: She sighs and looks away. I follow her eyes toward the sky, which is as bright as day.

spans.text: She sighs and looks away. I follow her eyes toward the sky, which is as bright as day.

units.rawText: ...This might be the first "day" that Burbank has ever seen. I hope the agents don't get the wrong impression from it.
units.displayText: ...This might be the first "day" that Burbank has ever seen. I hope the agents don't get the wrong impression from it.

spans.text: ...This might be the first "day" that Burbank has ever seen. I hope the agents don't get the wrong impression from it.

units.rawText: And what would the "wrong" impression be?
units.displayText: And what would the "wrong" impression be?

spans.text: And what would the "wrong" impression be?

units.rawText: For instance, that the Sun is made by the Earth.
units.displayText: For instance, that the Sun is made by the Earth.

spans.text: For instance, that the Sun is made by the Earth.

units.rawText: Yet that is not entirely impossible. After all, are Magrasea's sun and stars all not created objects?
units.displayText: Yet that is not entirely impossible. After all, are Magrasea's sun and stars all not created objects?

spans.text: Yet that is not entirely impossible. After all, are Magrasea's sun and stars all not created objects?

units.rawText: Day after day, it rises in the east and sets in the west. It travels its path without stopping, its mission clear in its heart, and it sees nothing else.
units.displayText: Day after day, it rises in the east and sets in the west. It travels its path without stopping, its mission clear in its heart, and it sees nothing else.

spans.text: Day after day, it rises in the east and sets in the west. It travels its path without stopping, its mission clear in its heart, and it sees nothing else.

units.rawText: Is there still nothing, even now?
units.displayText: Is there still nothing, even now?

spans.text: Is there still nothing, even now?

units.rawText: Now there is. No, perhaps there always was, from a long time ago.
units.displayText: Now there is. No, perhaps there always was, from a long time ago.

spans.text: Now there is. No, perhaps there always was, from a long time ago.

units.rawText: As we chat, a crisp chime comes from the screen in the sky.
units.displayText: As we chat, a crisp chime comes from the screen in the sky.

spans.text: As we chat, a crisp chime comes from the screen in the sky.

units.rawText: The progress bar up there is at 99%, and the remaining portion undoubtedly belongs to the stars on stage.
units.displayText: The progress bar up there is at 99%, and the remaining portion undoubtedly belongs to the stars on stage.

spans.text: The progress bar up there is at 99%, and the remaining portion undoubtedly belongs to the stars on stage.

units.rawText: This guy is surprisingly tough, as expected of the guy who used to teach us...
units.displayText: This guy is surprisingly tough, as expected of the guy who used to teach us...

spans.text: This guy is surprisingly tough, as expected of the guy who used to teach us...

units.rawText: He won't stop now just because you praised him.
units.displayText: He won't stop now just because you praised him.

spans.text: He won't stop now just because you praised him.

units.rawText: Though he's being held at bay by the two of them, Mysterious Warrior Omega does not panic. He calmly holds his ground.
units.displayText: Though he's being held at bay by the two of them, Mysterious Warrior Omega does not panic. He calmly holds his ground.

spans.text: Though he's being held at bay by the two of them, Mysterious Warrior Omega does not panic. He calmly holds his ground.

units.rawText: ...He's planning to absorb the sector's operands! We need to find a way to cut the connection between his section of the stage and the main control platform!
units.displayText: ...He's planning to absorb the sector's operands! We need to find a way to cut the connection between his section of the stage and the main control platform!

spans.text: ...He's planning to absorb the sector's operands! We need to find a way to cut the connection between his section of the stage and the main control platform!

units.rawText: That's way too complicated for me. However, watch this!
units.displayText: That's way too complicated for me. However, watch this!

spans.text: That's way too complicated for me. However, watch this!

units.rawText: Saying so, Mysterious Warrior S' armor shines brightly. As her raised sword falls, the stage is cut squarely in two!
units.displayText: Saying so, Mysterious Warrior S' armor shines brightly. As her raised sword falls, the stage is cut squarely in two!

spans.text: Saying so, Mysterious Warrior S' armor shines brightly. As her raised sword falls, the stage is cut squarely in two!

units.rawText: ...That's just ridiculous, not even Persicaria could do that when she absorbed all the operands of the Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: ...That's just ridiculous, not even Persicaria could do that when she absorbed all the operands of the Enigma Sector.

spans.text: ...That's just ridiculous, not even Persicaria could do that when she absorbed all the operands of the Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: Oh yes. I think that this must be Meryl's handiwork behind the scenes, causing the stage to separate by itself.
units.displayText: Oh yes. I think that this must be Meryl's handiwork behind the scenes, causing the stage to separate by itself.

spans.text: Oh yes. I think that this must be Meryl's handiwork behind the scenes, causing the stage to separate by itself.

options.rawText: Then these are some truly outrageous special effects.
options.displayText: Then these are some truly outrageous special effects.

spans.text: Then these are some truly outrageous special effects.

options.rawText: I like it when things have a big kick like this!
options.displayText: I like it when things have a big kick like this!

spans.text: I like it when things have a big kick like this!

units.rawText: Eos smiles and nods.
units.displayText: Eos smiles and nods.

spans.text: Eos smiles and nods.

units.rawText: I believe our bracelets should be the last two left.
units.displayText: I believe our bracelets should be the last two left.

spans.text: I believe our bracelets should be the last two left.

units.rawText: How should we deal with them, Professor?
units.displayText: How should we deal with them, Professor?

spans.text: How should we deal with them, Professor?
Let's cheer them on.
We're Mysterious Warriors too!

units.rawText: Our eyes meet. We smile, and then we raise our hands high and dissolve into the light.
units.displayText: Our eyes meet. We smile, and then we raise our hands high and dissolve into the light.

spans.text: Our eyes meet. We smile, and then we raise our hands high and dissolve into the light.

units.rawText: Sol and Nascita defeat the Entropized Omega and pin him to the stage.
units.displayText: Sol and Nascita defeat the Entropized Omega and pin him to the stage.

spans.text: Sol and Nascita defeat the Entropized Omega and pin him to the stage.

units.rawText: The progress bar in the sky reaches 100%, and with a crisp tone, it begins to rain colorful streamers in the Burbank Sector.
units.displayText: The progress bar in the sky reaches 100%, and with a crisp tone, it begins to rain colorful streamers in the Burbank Sector.

spans.text: The progress bar in the sky reaches 100%, and with a crisp tone, it begins to rain colorful streamers in the Burbank Sector.

units.rawText: At the same time, thunderous applause erupts throughout the sector.
units.displayText: At the same time, thunderous applause erupts throughout the sector.

spans.text: At the same time, thunderous applause erupts throughout the sector.
